name: The Weaving Loft
legend: # = wall, . = floor, P = player start, D = door slot (in the outer wall), C = chest, S = rest shrine
waves_note: Enemies arrive in waves: the next wave comes when 1 enemy (or none) is left.
artProps: Wooden beams, a big loom on the top wall, bolts of grey cloth, spools on the walls. A few loose Shadows (swarmers) come in two small waves, like the other Guardian rooms; the Loom Keeper itself calls no helpers.
